topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I really need to think this through. My neighbor just stopped by, asking if they could use a section of my yard for a garden. Part of me wants to say yes, just to be friendly, but I'm already stretched so thin. I barely have time to keep up with my own yard, let alone manage someone else's garden. Plus, I worry about what this could mean for my property. Will it look the way I want it to? What if the garden attracts pests? But refusing feels so harsh. I just can’t manage one more thing right now. I said I’d give it some thought, but honestly, I’m not sure what to do.
